SET LOCAL search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp

DO $$ BEGIN IF current_database() <> 'hmi_mes_demo' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unexpected database'; END IF; IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.alembic_version) <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.alembic_version WHERE version_num='0018_clock_evidence') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unexpected schema revision or database'; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='hmi_migrator') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='hmi_app') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dedicated roles required'; END IF; IF (SELECT nspowner FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='public') IS DISTINCT FROM 'hmi_migrator'::regrole::oid OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_class WHERE oid=to_regclass('public.alembic_version') AND relowner='hmi_migrator'::regrole::oid AND relkind='r') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dedicated migrator ownership required'; END IF; END $$

CREATE TABLE registration_id_counters (
        kind text NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('recipe','work_order')),
        namespace text NOT NULL CHECK(namespace ~ '^[^[:space:]]{1,128}$'),
        last_value numeric(20,0) NOT NULL
            CHECK(last_value BETWEEN 1 AND 9223372036854775807),
        PRIMARY KEY(kind,namespace)
    )

CREATE TABLE registration_receipts (
        kind text NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('recipe','work_order')),
        request_id text NOT NULL CHECK(request_id ~ '^[^[:space:]]{1,128}$'),
        actor text NOT NULL REFERENCES users(login) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        original_request jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(original_request)='object'),
        response jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(response)='object'),
        recipe_version_id text REFERENCES recipe_versions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        work_order_id text REFERENCES work_orders(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(kind,request_id),
        CHECK((kind='recipe' AND recipe_version_id IS NOT NULL AND work_order_id IS NULL)
            OR (kind='work_order' AND work_order_id IS NOT NULL AND recipe_version_id IS NULL))
    )

CREATE FUNCTION immutable_registration_receipt() RETURNS trigger
        LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Registration receipts are immutable';
        END $$

CREATE TRIGGER registration_receipts_immutable
        BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON registration_receipts FOR EACH ROW
        EXECUTE FUNCTION immutable_registration_receipt()

CREATE TRIGGER registration_receipts_no_truncate
        BEFORE TRUNCATE ON registration_receipts FOR EACH STATEMENT
        EXECUTE FUNCTION immutable_registration_receipt()
